roadmap.title: Finish the opening and establish Howling Hill
roadmap.description: Complete Chapters 1-3, unlock the challenge system, and activate the first permanent camp at Howling Hill.

roadmap.title: Prepare challenge tracking before clearing the world
roadmap.description: Activate all 8 Hidden Bells, collect the 141 Sealed Abyss Artifacts, and preserve populated camps and unique weapons while completing Mastery, Combat, and Life pages.

roadmap.title: Advance the story through Pailune and the Epilogue
roadmap.description: Complete Chapter 7, relocate the camp to Pailune, then finish all 12 chapters and enter the Epilogue so every story-gated activity can appear.

roadmap.title: Clear every Exploration subcategory
roadmap.description: Solve world puzzles, finish story-gated activities, obtain the Constellation Helm, defeat New Power bosses, and bring all nine Exploration groups to 100%.

roadmap.title: Finish every minigame group
roadmap.description: Visit each activity to reveal its page, then complete Shooting, Test of Strength, Duel, Racing, and Mind Games.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 1, @mechanic{The First Encounter}, and speak with the White Crow after leaving the Abyss Nexus.

guide.context: This is the first automatic story achievement and does not depend on difficulty or optional content.

steps.text: Follow the Chapter 1 main-quest markers through the Abyss Nexus, then finish the conversation with the @npc{White Crow} to complete the chapter.

achievements.description: Complete the activation of the camp at Howling Hill.
achievements.summary: Activate the @loc{Howling Hill} camp during the Chapter 3 main quests.

guide.context: Howling Hill becomes the first permanent camp through the story; no optional camp placement unlocks this achievement.

steps.text: Continue Chapter 3, @mechanic{Howling Hill}, and complete the main-quest objective that establishes and activates the camp.

achievements.summary: Solve all 4 Maze challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Exploration > Winding Paths}.

guide.context: Mazes are direct world puzzles, so they appear in white question-mark search areas and do not require Sealed Abyss Artifacts.

steps.text: At @loc{Maze of Burhum}, activate the three Force Palm buttons inside the shorter and taller towers, collect their Engraved Stones, and insert all three below the Cresset atop the tallest tower.
At @loc{Maze of Dawnreach}, use fully upgraded Force Palm three times on each leaning tower, take the two revealed Engraved Stones, and place them in the eastern tower's wall slots.

At @loc{Ancient Rift Maze}, northeast of Trovak Camp, open the three rooms with Focus Light using third pillar; first pillar; then two hits apiece on the outer pillars. Insert the three Engraved Stones at the lowest wall.

At @loc{Smoking Lands Desert Mouth Maze}, north of Hexe Sanctuary, use Force Palm or Force Current to flip every unlit sun-and-moon door shown on the floor map, including the one below the northwest hole.

achievements.summary: Complete all 8 Spire challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Exploration > Land Meets Sky}.

guide.context: Several Spires are tied to story progression, so an incomplete page can reflect unavailable content rather than a missed location.

steps.text: Clear the story Spires: @loc{Spire of the Stars} at Scholastone Institute in Chapter 4, @loc{Spire of Soaring} at Denn River in Chapter 5, @loc{Spire of the Sun} at Forebearer's Barrens in Chapter 9, and @loc{Jijeong Temple Pagoda} during Chapter 9's @mechanic{Face the Inner Self}.

Complete @loc{Spire of Insight} at Steel Mountain, @loc{Spire of Ringing Truth} at Wayward Woods, and @loc{Spire of Frost} at Deadfire Mountain. After Chapter 8's @mechanic{A Fleeting Dream} grants its key, also clear @loc{Spire of Clockwork} at Breezeblown Knoll.

achievements.summary: Use the @item{Constellation Helm} to complete all 13 @mechanic{Maps of the Night} constellation challenges.

guide.context: The Constellation Helm comes from the Hernand Scholastone Institute faction chain after most regional faction quests and the Kharonso Troll Alliance chain are complete.

steps.text: Advance the Scholastone Institute quests through @mechanic{Constellation Research} to @mechanic{Troll Studying Steles} and receive the @item{Constellation Helm}.
Equip the helm at every constellation location, resolve each pattern, and verify 13/13 under @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Exploration > Maps of the Night}.

achievements.summary: Complete all 6 Sword challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Mastery > Goyen's Advice}.

guide.context: One-off combat actions usually do not count before their challenge is unlocked, so reveal the pages before farming sword objectives.

steps.text: Find the 6 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before working on the Sword page.

Complete the six objectives: defeat 3 enemies in 30 seconds; defeat 3 at once; defeat 3 without damage; hit 3 at once with Turning Slash; defeat 3 consecutively using only Sword Stab; then defeat 5 in 15 seconds using Forward Slash. Use completed artifacts and verify 6/6.

achievements.summary: Complete all 6 Shield challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Mastery > Goyen's Advice}.

guide.context: The first Shield page asks for 3 enemy defeats with a shield, but later requirements remain hidden until their artifacts are found.

steps.text: Find the 6 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before working on the Shield page.

Defeat 3 enemies with a shield; block 10 arrows; hit 3 enemies in one attack; defeat 5 without damage; flip 5 enemies with Damiane's shield throw; and use Charge to hit 10 different enemies within 1 minute. Finalize the artifacts and verify 6/6.

achievements.summary: Complete all 6 Bow challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Mastery > Goyen's Advice}.

guide.context: Bow kills and special shots performed before their challenge pages appear may not be credited.

steps.text: Find the 6 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before working on the Bow page.

With bows, defeat 5 enemies in 60 seconds and 7 consecutively using only normal arrows; hit 3 enemies during one airborne period; shoot 3 birds from beyond 15 metres; defeat 5 enemies from beyond 20 metres in one sequence; and tag 5 different enemies with Focused Shot. Finalize the artifacts and verify 6/6.

achievements.summary: Complete all 5 Spear challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Mastery > Goyen's Advice}.

guide.context: The standard Spear category is separate from Special Weapons even when a unique special weapon is spear-shaped.

steps.text: Find the 5 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before working on the standard Spear page.

Land 15 spear counterattacks in 30 seconds; score 50 spear hits in 30 seconds; defeat 5 enemies in 15 seconds with Stab; defeat 3 in 1 minute with aerial Spear attacks; and defeat 5 while staying at full health. Finalize the artifacts and verify 5/5.

achievements.summary: Complete all 6 Two-Handed Weapon challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Mastery > Goyen's Advice}.

guide.context: Progress begins only after each linked Sealed Abyss Artifact reveals its requirement.

steps.text: Find the 6 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before working on the Two-Handed Weapon page.

For the club-or-axe set, launch 5 enemies together, defeat 10 without being hit, and connect 30 times inside 30 seconds. For the longsword set, knock back 10 enemies inside 30 seconds, finish 3 enemies without damage, and strike 3 together while below 50% health. Finalize the artifacts and verify 6/6.

achievements.summary: Complete all 5 Cannon challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Mastery > Goyen's Advice}.

guide.context: Cannon objectives belong to Mastery rather than the similarly named Combat Operation category.

steps.text: Find the 5 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before working on the Cannon page.

Use a Hand Cannon to hit 3 enemies at once; defeat 3 enemies with each normal, Fire, Ice, Lightning, and Wind Charged Shot; defeat 10 in 30 seconds without breaking scenery; defeat a mounted enemy from at least 30 metres; and destroy 2 Watchtowers within 10 seconds. Finalize the artifacts and verify 5/5.

achievements.description: Complete all rapier and shield challenges.
achievements.summary: Complete all 5 Rapier and Shield challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Mastery > Goyen's Advice}.

guide.context: Use the combined Rapier and Shield page; progress on the separate Shield category does not replace these five challenges.

steps.text: Find the 5 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before working on the Rapier and Shield page.

With a rapier, defeat 5 enemies in 60 seconds, make 10 stabs without damage, strike prone enemies 5 times, and defeat 3 enemies together from beyond 10 metres; then hit 9 enemies within 15 seconds using Shield Toss. Finalize the artifacts and verify 5/5.

achievements.summary: Complete all 5 Gun challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Mastery > Goyen's Advice}.

guide.context: Firearm actions performed before their five pages are revealed may not count toward completion.

steps.text: Find the 5 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before working on the Gun page.

Use guns to defeat 5 enemies from beyond 30 metres; defeat 3 from beyond 5 metres within 5 seconds; land 3 pistol hits in 1 second; hit 7 mounted enemies while riding; and defeat 3 enemies apiece with regular shots, Evasive or Focused Evasive shots, and aerial shots. Finalize the artifacts and verify 5/5.

achievements.summary: Complete all 10 Training challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Combat > Goyen's Advice}.

guide.context: Training is a Combat subcategory and is distinct from the weapon pages grouped under Mastery.

steps.text: Find the 10 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before working on the Training page.

Use wrestling to subdue 3 opponents in 1 minute; reach 10 metres with Aerial Force Palm; slide 50 metres; pole-vault with a Banner Pike 5 times in 30 seconds; walk 10 metres on a rope; and parry 7 times without damage.

Also hit enemies 6 times with each normal, Fire, Ice, Lightning, and Wind Turning Slash; land Diving Force Palm twice without touching ground; sprint-swim 100 metres without rest; and cling to a bear for over 10 seconds. Finalize the artifacts and verify 10/10.

achievements.summary: Complete all 10 Battle challenges before exhausting the populated combat areas needed for their objectives.

guide.context: Learn Meteor Kick from Kliff's level-5 Unarmed Combat node. Save before Chapter 8's Rebel Suppression because its Thornbriar Fortress cannons provide the cleanest five-kill shot; Fort Windridge is the fallback.

steps.text: Find the 10 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before fully liberating enemy camps, then open @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Combat > Goyen's Advice > Battle}.

Destroy 3 Watchtowers inside 20 seconds; defeat 7 enemies through one explosion and 5 through one cannon attack; connect Blinding Flash with 5 targets together; and land 9 Force Palm strikes inside 5 seconds. For Meteor Kick, jump or launch with mid-air Force Palm, trigger its charged downward slam while airborne, and accumulate 30 hits before 3 minutes pass.

Defeat 3 enemies unarmed inside 1 minute and connect Giant Swing 7 times inside 30 seconds. For the sleeping targets, finish Longleaf's questline, dispatch a Greymane Expedition there for 20 Sleep Arrows, put five enemies to sleep, and attack them. Restore allies 3 times through Force Palm: Healing, finalize the artifacts, and verify 10/10.

achievements.summary: Complete all 10 Operation challenges, including @mechanic{Disruption}, before clearing their required faction encounters.

guide.context: Buy the Black Bear's Leather Helm from Pailune's Tailor in Chapter 8. Use Jackals at Whispering Forest Dock before liberation or those spawned by the later Pailune faction quest @mechanic{The Jackals' Scheme}; finishing every faction quest can still remove this route.

steps.text: Find the 10 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} early and preserve Pailune camps and faction quests until the Jackal-dependent page is complete.

Obtain a @item{Disruptor} from a fallen backpack-wearing Ironflame Orc in Gorthak before liberation. For the Chapter 12 fallback, complete @mechanic{Delesyian Institute: Basic Science Research} at the @loc{City of Delesyia} research facility, dispatch a Greymane Expedition to @loc{Rustfield Scrapyard}, and collect its Disruptor. Hit 10 grouped machines at once with the Disruptor. Also defeat 10 Banner Pike soldiers in Demeniss within 30 minutes, make 5 nighttime assassinations, defeat 30 enemies inside 1 minute, commit a crime in Delesyia while wearing Varnian Contribution Armor, and commit a crime in Varnia while wearing Delesyian Contribution Armor.

Destroy 2 Palisade Gates at night, clear the Storm Veil guards, and make 3 assassinations inside 1 minute. Play as @npc{Damiane} and defeat a starburst-marked Elite using guns alone. Equip the @item{Black Bear's Leather Helm} and defeat 10 One-Eyed Jackals through the preserved Dock or faction-quest route, then finalize the artifacts and verify 10/10.

achievements.summary: Complete all 5 Trade challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Life > White Crow's Gaze}.

guide.context: Trade has its own five-page group and does not complete through the general Life or Hunting counters.

steps.text: Find the 5 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before working on the Trade page.

Raise more than 300,000 Camp Funds through trade; deliver goods separately to the Hernandian, Demenissian, Varnian, and Delesyian royal courts; visit the 4 Witches' workshops; and meet the 8 regional tavern owners. Learn every dyeing technique from Cromac, Alton, Laurick, Castiel, Pororin, Monty, and Theoric. Finalize the artifacts and verify 5/5.

achievements.summary: Defeat all 7 New Power bosses for @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Exploration > Primal Frenzy}.

guide.context: The New Power page appears in Chapter 12; most fights require their regional faction quests, while earlier boss defeats are credited when the page opens.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 12, finish the faction access required for each @enemy{New Power boss}, defeat all 7, and verify 7/7 under @mechanic{Primal Frenzy}.

achievements.description: Complete all Above the Law challenges.
achievements.summary: Complete all 10 Above the Law challenges before clearing the enemy content needed for their objectives.

guide.context: This category has been patch-sensitive because some requirements depend on enemy content that may disappear after regional cleanup.

steps.text: Find the 10 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} early and open @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Life > Master Du's Dare > Above the Law}.

Build the camp ranch through @mechanic{Grounds of the Sunrise > Gathered Will > Field of Abundance}, finish @mechanic{Ben's Request}, and bring 3 goats to Bram's middle ranch stall. Complete @mechanic{Strongbox with Wheels}, then fence 3 stolen wagons and 10 pigs. Track Bounty Notices, tackle 3 Outlaws alive, and return each to its associated capital constabulary.

Pickpocket in Hernand, Demeniss, and Delesyia; open 20 locked doors; steal 5 objects inside 10 seconds; and dismantle 10 Banner Pikes undetected after dark. Wear a mask and steal the rear-cupboard candle in West Demeniss Church, the altar candle in East Demeniss Church, and the altar candle in the Cathedral of Demeniss.

Raise the bounty to the 100-silver cap by committing crimes, let a guard tackle you, deliberately fail the arrest QTE, and enter jail to satisfy @mechanic{The Crow's Crown and the Last Chivalry}. Finalize the artifacts and verify 10/10.

achievements.description: Complete all Challenges and Changes challenges.
achievements.summary: Complete all 9 Challenges and Changes entries in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Life > Alustin's Trials}.

guide.context: The Journal names this group Challenges and Changes, while the achievement description uses a shortened version of that label.

steps.text: Find the 9 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before working on the Challenges and Changes page.

Reach the ground from an Abyss within 30 seconds; visit all 12 Greymane Shrines; find 20 Greymanes; complete Howling Hill Camp's second expansion; travel 2 kilometres without moving yourself; and acquire the Hernandian, Demenissian, and Delesyian Signets plus the Tashkalp Seal.

In Duo, earn a 3-win streak and win a 4-player match. At the @loc{Tashkalp} Duo table, watch for an opponent pulling a hand upward toward the throat instead of sideways; enter the blue detection view and choose the literal @mechanic{Accuse} prompt. Finalize the artifacts and verify 9/9.

achievements.description: Complete the camp relocation to Pailune.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 7, @mechanic{Homecoming}, then relocate the camp from @loc{Howling Hill} to @loc{Pailune}.

guide.context: The relocation is a separate main-quest event that becomes available only after Chapter 7 is complete.

steps.text: After completing @mechanic{Homecoming}, follow the main-quest relocation objective and confirm the camp's move to @loc{Pailune}.

achievements.summary: Reach all 60 Secret Places listed under @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Exploration > Wandering Footsteps}.

guide.context: The map labels these sites Abyss Cressets; reaching one awards a skill-point Artifact and opens its travel waypoint.

steps.text: Use Lantern or Guiding Light inside white question-mark areas and reach these first 20 Abyss Cressets: Precipice of Silence; Giant Hand of Windy Hills; Breathless Lake; Peak's Green Bloom; Lava Under Snowy Plains; Blazing Sand; A Detailed Glance; Giant Hand of Everfrost; Trial of the Sandscale; The Southern End; The Desert's Oasis; Cliffside Marine Erosion Pillar; A Hill Guided By Light; Guide in the Darkness; Where Sky Meets Earth; Rock Worn Down by the Ocean Wind; An Unreachable End; Rock Atop the Altar; Subtle Gap; Haven Past the Snowfall.

Continue with Windcrest; Hill of the Abandoned; Wrecked Dream; Hill of Serenity; The Stairway Falls; Strange Rift; Peak of Enlightenment; Sanctuary of Reflection; Thunderwater Falls; Edge of Learning; Threefold Fork; The Secret-Laden Cave; Peak of the Innovative Mind; Cape of Hope; Hunter's Overlook; Forgotten Cliff; Saltshade Hill; Everflowing Spring; Crimson Ridge; Hangman's Crest.

Finish Peak of Abundance; Arehaza Peak; Hill of Grief; Remnants of Ruin; The Desert's End; Howlsands Dunes; Mushroomcap Cliff; Ivory Marches Garden; Whitesand Cliff; Cliff of Ruination; The Wolf's Molar; The Sage's Rest; Where the Stars Linger; Hill of Longing; Silverwolf Lake; Ancestor's Rest; Peak of Grief; The Dragon's Gaze; Sandsea Waymark; and Watcher on the Cliff.

achievements.summary: Solve all 37 Ancient Ruins in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Exploration > The Thread in the Forest}.

guide.context: Ancient Ruins are direct environmental puzzles in white question-mark search areas and do not need Sealed Abyss Artifacts.

steps.text: Every base label in this checklist ends with @loc{Ruins} in the Journal. Solve the first 13: Steel Mountains; Trembling Woods; Deepfog Basin Everfrost; Duskwood Hill; Timberdale Cliff; Timberdale Gorge; Hunter's Cabin; Wiggling Hill; Blue Thicket; Black Wall; Meandering Hills; Duskwood Waterside; Beardtree Hills Rock.

Continue through Precipice of Echoes; Deepfog Basin Dragon Head; Five-Finger Mountain Icy; Five-Finger Mountain Valley; Red River; Bamboo Forest Seonangdang; Kingshield Mountains; Sunrise Plains; Golden Plains; Arboria Forest; Fuming Lands; Beardtree Hills Sunflower; Silver Wolf Mountain; Haunted Hill.

Finish Halssius Conflux; The Grey Forest; Drakesfall Gorge; Mount Benus; Dragon's Stone Chamber; Hidden Chamber of Wisdom; Secret Chamber of the Golden Plains; The Screaming Vault; Memory-Laden; and Azure Moon Labyrinth. Treat each as its full Journal label ending in @loc{Ruins}, activate the resulting Abyss Cresset, and verify 37/37.

achievements.summary: Restore all 16 Sanctums in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Exploration > The Forgotten Sun}.

guide.context: Sanctums are Exploration locations rather than artifact-locked Mastery pages.

steps.text: Meet the four Witches and keep the @item{Kuku Pot} from Chapter 4's @mechanic{The Iron Pot's Usage}. For each Sanctum, clear the enemies, reconnect the broken pillar with Axiom Force and Force Palm, and place its power core into the reactor; seal unreachable cores in the Kuku Pot, then discard them beside the reactor.

Complete Absolution, Temperance, Penitence, Benediction, Exaltation, Solace, Deliverance, Atonement, Devotion, Veneration, Oblation, Faith, Expiation, Renunciation, and Revelation through their Witch quests. Finish Mortification during Chapter 9's @mechanic{Fragments of Darkness}, then verify 16/16.

achievements.summary: Complete all 10 Special Weapons challenges without selling, discarding, breaking, or converting their required unique weapons first.

guide.context: Some unique weapons can be recovered through Expeditions, but recovery has not been established for every item, so retain each original until its page is finished.

steps.text: Find the 10 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts}. After Chapter 11, complete @mechanic{Weapon Heat-Treatment Research} at @loc{Zargan Tankworks}, then dispatch a Greymane Expedition to @loc{Gorthak Ironworks} for the Flamespitter. After Chapter 12 liberates Delesyia, dispatch to the @loc{Aeronautical Research Base} for the Shotgun Shield. Obtain the Propeller Spear and Gale Shield through Great Gate of Urdavah research and Helmara Expeditions; obtain the Knuckledrill from the @mechanic{Stolen Quarry} step of House Roberts' @mechanic{Estate in Dismay}, or through Karin Quarry production.

Record 30 defeats apiece with the Bismuth Spear and Lightning Spear. Trigger the Knuckledrill's overheat blast against enemies 5 times, catch 5 enemies in one Propeller Spear wind attack, and ignite 10 enemies through the Flamespitter before 15 seconds pass.

Craft Lightning Spears after Chapter 12 Dewhaven Keep research or dispatch Steelspike Armory, and obtain Bismuth Spears by liberating Well of Enlightenment and dispatching there. Clear the Beighen Tribe and Longleaf Tribe chains together with the Pailune Militia and Skoghorn Tribe chains, then finish the Stjar Clan's @mechanic{Master of Thunder} to receive the @item{Lightning Bolt Plate Armor}; receiving this armor completes the displayed @mechanic{Obtain Titan's armor} challenge. Do not convert any required weapon into a Kuku variant because Kuku versions do not count.

Take the base Marni Laser Helm from Marni's Masterium and do not sell, discard, or convert it before its 5 hits. Complete @mechanic{Antumbra's Sword} at the Sanctum of Absolution for the one-per-playthrough Vessel of Dark Pursuit and retain it through 100 defeats. Use the Shotgun Shield for 30 defeats and the Gale Shield for 30 subdues, then finalize the artifacts and verify 10/10.

achievements.summary: Complete all 10 Horse challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Mastery > Goyen's Advice}.

guide.context: Horse challenges are grouped under Mastery even though their objectives center on riding and taming rather than weapon combat.

steps.text: Find the 10 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before working on the Horse page.

Tame 2 wild horses; from horseback, hunt 5 animals in 5 minutes and defeat 20 enemies in 5 minutes without stopping; ride from Sunset Valley to Varnia within 40 minutes; and mount a horse from the air 3 times.

Tame Royler, Rokade, and Camora; travel from Delesyia to Pailune during one night; ram 30 enemies into submission inside 5 minutes; ride each of Elantrima, Numont, Brianto, and Priden beyond 100 metres; and complete the Silvermoon Tradehouse-to-Vellua route before 10 minutes pass. Finalize the artifacts and verify 10/10.

achievements.summary: Finish the 15 minigame entries: 5 Duel and 3 Mind Games, plus 4 Test of Strength, 2 Shooting, and 1 Racing challenge.

guide.context: Minigame pages appear after first use. The Five-Card page requires the Odeck version unlocked by Pailune's Odeck Tribe faction quest @mechanic{Executioner of Justice}; other Five-Card tables do not reveal it.

steps.text: Visit and interact with every minigame type to reveal its entries in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Minigame}.

For Shooting, earn 3-win streaks and beat the Archery and Shooting champions. Do the same for the five Duel disciplines and Horse Racing. For Test of Strength, separately clear Arm Wrestling at Hernand Castle; Calphade after Oongka's @mechanic{Strength Held in the Fingertips}; Pailune after @mechanic{Arm Wrestling of the Wages}; and Hand Wrestling south of Delesyia, winning three opponents and then each champion.
For Mind Games, win Rock, Paper, Scissors 3 times; in both Duo and Five-Card, earn a 3-win streak and record wins against tables containing 1, 2, and 3 opponents.

achievements.summary: Complete the Chapter 7 main-quest chain, @mechanic{Homecoming}, to protect Pailune.

guide.context: This is an automatic story unlock and occurs before the separate objective that relocates the camp to Pailune.

steps.text: Follow every Chapter 7 main-quest marker and finish the final @mechanic{Homecoming} objective.

achievements.summary: Complete all 11 Hunting challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Life > White Crow's Gaze}.

guide.context: Hunting has its own Life subcategory and is separate from the 22 Legendary Animals required for Exploration.

steps.text: Find the 11 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before working on the Hunting page.

Carry 5 different birds; defeat 3 wolves unarmed; defeat 3 hyenas while staying within 20 metres; capture 3 Choppies; defeat 10 Stoneback Crabs; carry 5 different weasel-family animals; and subdue 3 herbivores, 3 predators, and 3 omnivores.

Skin animals until all five hide classes are obtained, and hunt the four named targets: White Bison, White-Scaled Crocodile, White Bear, and Silver Fang. Defeat a bear with nothing but a broom, then hang from a wolf and deliver 6 uninterrupted stabs. Finalize the artifacts and verify 11/11.

achievements.summary: Complete all 12 Life challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Life > White Crow's Gaze}, including knowledge from 100 caves.

guide.context: Cave Exploration Log is the largest known requirement in this group, and visited caves gain map icons while completed locations receive checkmarks.

steps.text: Find the 12 linked @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} before working on the Life page.
Complete the knowledge sets for 3 mushrooms, 22 medicinal herbs, 6 poisonous herbs, 18 minerals, 8 meats, 76 insects and arthropods, 17 grains, 37 vegetables and fruits, and 8 rare gatherables.

Acquire knowledge from 100 caves and tame 30 different pets. At the smithy, make both a bow and a one-handed sword; prepare 3 field dishes plus 3 meals that require special cooking tools; gather 5 normal, 5 fine, and 5 flawless timber; and finish the knowledge sets for 25 freshwater fish, 15 saltwater fish, 5 legendary fish, and 11 underwater wildlife. Finalize the artifacts and verify 12/12.

achievements.summary: Reach the Epilogue after clearing the Prologue and all 12 story chapters, then finish @mechanic{A New Beginning}.

guide.context: The achievement is automatic at the start of the Epilogue, and free roam remains available after the main story.

steps.text: Follow the main-quest chain through Chapter 12, enter the Epilogue, and finish @mechanic{A New Beginning}.

achievements.summary: Complete all 40 Abyss challenges in @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Exploration > Restoration}.

guide.context: These are the 40 The Abyss entries under Exploration and should not be confused with the 60 Secret Places.

steps.text: Finish the story and all 8 Spires, switch to the sky map, and activate each Skybridge by rotating its blue pillar with Axiom Force until it glows. Begin with Axiom Archive, Ethereal Pathway, Root's End, and Precipice of Truth.

Clear the Stars cluster through Sanctorum of Insight, Secret Garden, and Vault of Vengeance; continue to Courtyard of Precision, then Altar of Solitude and Ice Cradle. Clear Soaring through Crescent Skybridge, Crow's Nest, and Monolith Crown; clear Insight through Chaos Forest and Roots of Truth.

For Ringing Truth, traverse Ether Rest, Frostbitten Paradise, and Path of Trials, then enter Sanctorum of Darkness. Continue onward through Loop of Life, Tree of Slumber, Skyloop Bridge, and Twisted Thicketway. For Frost, begin at Passage of Malice and Tomb of Perdition, then move through Desert Fragment and Cradle of Truth. For Clockwork, clear Riddle Square, Origin of Thoughts, and Forgotten Altar before Disconnected Truth and Ether Fragment.

For Sun, clear Nest of Valor and Throne of Truth before Dimensional Labyrinth and Sanctum of Transcendence. From Jijeong Temple Pagoda, clear Ascetic's Rest before Path of Serpents and Crossroads of Uncertainty. Finish Chapter 12's Dimensional Bonds, solve every island repair, and verify 40/40.

achievements.summary: Complete all 9 Exploration groups: 40 Abyss, 60 Secret Places, 37 Ancient Ruins, 4 Mazes, 16 Sanctums, 8 Spires, 13 Constellations, 22 Legendary Animals, and 7 New Power.

guide.context: This aggregate achievement includes the eight dedicated exploration achievements plus the separate Hazy Tales page for Legendary Animals.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Exploration} and bring Restoration, Wandering Footsteps, The Thread in the Forest, Winding Paths, The Forgotten Sun, Land Meets Sky, Maps of the Night, Hazy Tales, and Primal Frenzy to 100%.

achievements.summary: Finish all 64 Mastery entries across Horse, Gun, Sword, Special Weapons, Cannon, Shield, Bow, Rapier and Shield, Spear, and Two-Handed Weapon.

guide.context: The aggregate inherits the Special Weapons risk, so retain every unique weapon until its individual challenge page is complete.

steps.text: Bring all 10 subcategories under @mechanic{Journal > Challenges > Mastery} to 100%, then use any completed @item{Sealed Abyss Artifacts} still waiting in the inventory.
